description: Interior design project for a 65 m² apartment by DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia). Functional planning, bespoke furniture, custom storage, technical documentation, photorealistic 3D visualization, and complete turnkey renovation.
h1: Interior design project of a 65 m² apartment

blocks.text: Interior design project of a 65 m² apartment

parts.html: In this project, DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) delivered a full-scope interior design project for a 65 m² apartment, including interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture design and production, and turnkey renovation.

The design covered all areas of the apartment, including the living room, bedroom, kitchen with tailored storage solutions and built-in appliances, wardrobes, hallway, bathroom, cabinets, and shelving.

Bespoke furniture was designed for each area, carefully adapted to the apartment layout and the client’s individual needs, preferences, and lifestyle. Special attention was given to functionality, efficient storage, and creating a comfortable and visually balanced living environment.

Before construction and renovation works began, the client received a detailed cost estimate covering every stage of the project — from construction and finishing works and materials to custom furniture, appliances, plumbing, and lighting.

The project is presented through photorealistic 3D visualizations and photographs of the completed interior, demonstrating how the original design concept was transformed into a functional and comfortable living space.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) creates residential and commercial interiors across Slovakia, Europe, and the USA, providing comprehensive services from interior design and technical documentation to bespoke furniture production and turnkey implementation.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interiors that come to life.
